features.name: Automatic branch creation per task
features.detail: POST …/gitflow/run-branch creates agent/<runId> (convention kept so PR→run linking works) idempotently, writer-role only, tenant-checked, base ref validated. Not run against live GitHub.

features.name: Git worktree isolation per agent
features.detail: WorktreeManager (real git, disposable repos) gives one worktree+branch per run, confined under a root outside the repo, idempotent create, dirty/clean/recover, hostile repo config+hooks proven inert (mutation-checked). It is a host-side library with no HTTP route and is NOT yet running inside S5-managed execution boundaries: S5 must own where these worktrees live and run.

features.name: Automatic commit drafting
features.detail: Deterministic, explainable drafts (type + stated basis, file list, evidence count, Harness-Run/Co-authored-by trailers sanitised against injection) and a commit_paths that stages only named paths with human author/bot committer, forbidden/.git/traversal rejected, hooks off. No LLM drafting.

features.name: Pull-request creation from a completed run
features.detail: Governed draft-PR flow (branch must exist, draft enforced, idempotent incl. lost-race, run linkage via existing record_pr_opened, no merge path) verified against a fake GitHub only. Live provider and a full real run→PR drill are unverified.

features.name: Pull-request description generation
features.detail: Evidence-based description that states 'no verification evidence' when absent, flags failing checks, neutralises @mentions and auto-close keywords from untrusted goal text. Content quality with real runs is unevaluated.

features.name: Review-request routing
features.state: VERIFIED IMPLEMENTED (local); live reviewer-request semantics NEEDS EXTERNAL VALIDATION
features.detail: CODEOWNERS parser (last-match-wins, anchoring, ** , GitHub's non-recursive trailing wildcard, ownerless=unowned), author exclusion, ranking, 15 cap, unroutable/unowned reporting; reviewers requested only on first open (no re-ping on retry).

risks.note: Run→draft PR is one call; no usability study.
Reviewer routing + evidence-bearing draft PRs make review native; no live provider journey.
Routing avoids manual reviewer picking; approval overhead unmeasured.
